scope: Manual representative display correction; not an underground railway survey
stationGroup: Oshiage B1 Keisei/Toei Asakusa only; B3 and surface Tobu excluded
method: Native screenshot visually selected labelled black passenger rail supports, georeferenced with AX map corners and zero pitch/yaw; map rect [255,149,1024,679]. Pixel picking uncertainty approx 5–10px; hidden platform rails not measured.

representativePlatformPoint.basis: Complete separate B1 platform-body band midpoint: SW face C(368472)/(415548), midpoint(392510); NE face NE(587332)/(634408), midpoint(611370), registered back to C≈(957146). Midpoint C≈(675328), choose C(675330) within pixel uncertainty. Excludes concourse appendages and viewport clipping.

platformTangentDegreesFromEast: Derived from final representative point towards the independently visible NE platform-body end (approximately33°)
hiddenConnection: Short local constrained display connection from exposed entry to platform ray; neither full rectangle-axis snapping nor generic 120m window. Original physical route/mileage untouched.

firstPassPoint.basis: Point in middle of the separate oblique B1 platform-body band at the registered station longitudinal neighbourhood; avoids southeast edge and southern concourse appendage. Representative central display anchor, not a surveyed individual platform track.

platformNortheastEnd.basis: NE pair exposes complete B1 platform-body face, not top edge of clipped central image.
